messages:
maria: quick async sync — starting phased cutover for adaptive-routing-v3 now (slice=us-east-1a, 2%)
akshay: ack. what I did: pushed route config, validated smoke tests.
akshay: blocker: noticed ~0.8s tail latency on a small subset of seq>1024 requests, investigating.
jordan: what I did: deployed cache warmup job, primed top-100 prefixes. no blockers.
lee: what I did: updated feature-flag to allow automatic fallback to v2 for errors >0.5%.
lee: note: I set manual kill-switch at 10 failures/minute for the slice.
product-alyssa: observing user flows in staging, looks fine. can you post the smoke command you ran?
maria: smoke command:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.test/v1/generate -d '{"model":"adaptive-routing-v3","prompt":"hi","max_tokens":16}'
```
akshay: thanks. repro log snippet:
```
2026-02-14T16:02:12Z request_id=abc123 seq_len=1300 latency=820ms
2026-02-14T16:02:13Z request_id=abc124 seq_len=1400 latency=900ms
```
sre-raja: monitoring: small error bump in us-east starting +3m, 0.24% -> 0.78%. still below auto-fallback but trending.
product-alyssa: can we hold ramp beyond 2% if it keeps trending? prefer keep at 2% and investigate.
maria: agreed, holding at 2%. akshay/lee, could you triage the seq>1024 latency cause? maybe quantization path?
akshay: on it. hypothesis: kernel selection fallback for long contexts. running perf job now.
jordan: I'm going to throttle background batchers for that slice to reduce resource contention.
devops-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout started for adaptive-routing-v3 in us-east-1a (slice=2%). build=adp-v3-20260214-9
lee: quick config diff I applied:
```
- routing.fallback_threshold = 0.5
+ routing.fallback_threshold = 0.5
+ resources.kv_cache_priority = high
```
lee: also raised per-request CPU quota on that slice.
sre-raja: alert: increased 5xx rate to 0.6% for 60s — watching, not auto-failing yet.
maria: thanks. next steps: akshay debug kernel path, jordan keep batchers throttled, lee keep flag/watchers ready.
maria: expected update cadence: post findings by +20m, if no resolution escalate to full rollback.
product-alyssa: FYI we'll pause feature gating for new beta users until green.
akshay: initial perf diff shows warm vs cold kernels for seq>1k, sending more logs (uploading to /tmp/adp-v3-traces)
akshay: update in 10.
jordan: reducing batcher concurrency from 6 -> 3 for the slice.
maria: thumbs if you see any user-facing regressions :thumbsup:
lee: :thumbsup:
akshay: :eyes:
sre-raja: keeping dashboards pinned, will post graphs if trends continue.
maria: closing note: if auto-fallback triggers, paging list will get notified. otherwise keep async updates here.
devops-bot: monitor-bot: next evaluation check in 15m — will post snapshot metrics then.
